title: Introduce rapid-reinstate latch, circuit throttle and canary evacuation flow
author: Priya Kapoor
description: Motivation: production incident on 2026-02-20 revealed a repeat pattern where nodes that were evacuated for KV pressure or network flakiness immediately rejoined and triggered another evacuation within seconds; this caused SLO churn and cascading circuit flips. This PR introduces a small, runtime-focused safety layer: (1) a rapid-reinstate latch that enforces a short, adaptive cooldown window before a recently-evacuated circuit/node can be fully reinstated; (2) a per-tenant circuit throttle that temporarily reduces admission for tenants that cause rapid rejoin cycles; and (3) a canary evacuation flow that drains a small fraction of traffic to candidate nodes first and verifies KV affinity and latency before broad evacuations. Summary of changes: - controlplane/controller: add RapidReinstateManager with an adaptive cooldown policy based on recent evacuation frequency and node health metrics - serving/runtime: introduce circuitThrottle hook to the admission path; respects tenant weight and global emergency throttle - autoscaler/evac: canaryEvacuation mode that drains k=5% of connections to target nodes, runs lightweight KV affinity checks, and only continues if checks pass - config: new defaults under runtime.safety.rapid_reinstate and runtime.safety.canary_evacuations; flags for canary window and cooldown - CLI: redwoodctl evac --canary flag to trigger canary mode for manual evacuations - telemetry: add metrics rapid_reinstate.cooldown_seconds, circuit_throttle.rate_limited_tenants, canary_evacuations.attempts/result - docs: runtime/operational/evacuation.md with rollout/migration guidance Checklist: - [x] unit tests for RapidReinstateManager logic - [x] integration test: simulated repeated evacuations with node flapping - [x] e2e: small cluster canary evacuation flow - [x] telemetry dashboard tile for rapid_reinstate and canary_evacuations - [x] migration doc and rollback plan Related: ENG-2145 (SLO stability followup), ENG-3310 (evacuation tooling improvements), SUP-512 (customer incident). Testing notes: This change was exercised in benchmark-lab under a 50-node cluster: simulated KV pressure + network jitter for 30 minutes; with rapid-reinstate enabled, circuit flip rate dropped ~78% and SLO violation windows reduced from 18 to 4 seconds median. Performance impact: minor additional checks on control plane paths; no synchronous blocking on token path. Rollout plan: 1) Merge to main behind feature flag runtime.safety.rapid_reinstate.enabled=false and runtime.safety.canary_evacuations.enabled=false 2) Enable in staging for 48 hours and monitor metrics 3) Gradual ramp to 10% of regions as runtime flags are toggled 4) Full enable after 72 hours of stable metrics Monitoring / alerts: New SLO-oriented alerts added in observability-pack: - rapid_reinstate.cooldown_exceeded (unexpectedly long cooldowns) - canary_evacuations.failure_rate > 5% (alerts to oncall) - circuit_throttle.rate_limited_tenants spike (investigate tenant behavior) Migration & rollback: No DB schema changes. Config-only rollout. Rollback is a single flag flip and optional requeue of any partially drained canaries via redwoodctl evac --cancel-canary. Backwards compatibility: default values keep behavior unchanged until flags turned on. Security considerations: no secrets or new surface exposed. Ops runbook excerpt: - If tenants show unexpected rate limiting, use redwoodctl throttle inspect <tenant> to review counters and unblock temporarily. Commits (summary): - a1b2c3f: implement RapidReinstateManager and unit tests - d4e5f6a: add circuitThrottle hook and tenant rate limiter - 7f8e9d0: implement canaryEvacuation mode and CLI flag - 0aa111b: telemetry + dashboards + docs - b22c333: e2e test for canary flow and integration harness Changes (files touched, high level): - controlplane/rapid_reinstate.go (new) - runtime/admission/circuit_throttle.go (new) - autoscaler/evac/canary.go (new) - cmd/redwoodctl/evac.go (CLI flag) - observability/dashboards/rapid_reinstate.json (dashboard) - docs/operational/evacuation.md (docs) - tests/integration/rapid_reinstate_test.go (tests) - Makefile / CI config updates - pkg/config/defaults.yaml (config knobs) Merge notes: squash merge after final approval. Followup work: ENG-3412 to add tenant-level diagnostics to the dashboard, ENG-3413 to expose a per-region canary failure history endpoint.

release_notes:
- Added adaptive rapid-reinstate cooldown to prevent immediate circuit rejoin flips
- Introduced tenant-aware circuit throttle to reduce churn from noisy tenants
- Added canary evacuation mode for safer, gradual node replacements
- New telemetry and dashboard tiles for rapid_reinstate and canary_evacuations
